name: Keyboardrowalternatingshift

description_json.name: KeyboardRowAlternatingShift
description_json.idea: A keyboard-based cipher that alternates shifts to the right and left on standard QWERTY rows. Odd-positioned alphabetic characters in the text are shifted to their immediate right neighbor on their keyboard row (wrapping around). Even-positioned alphabetic characters are shifted to their immediate left neighbor on their keyboard row (wrapping around). Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged and do not count toward the alternating index.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Identify the QWERTY row for each letter: Row 1 (qwertyuiop), Row 2 (asdfghjkl), Row 3 (zxcvbnm). Maintain a counter for alphabetic characters starting at 1. For the 1st, 3rd, 5th... alphabetic character, shift it to its immediate right neighbor in its row (e.g., q->w, p->q). For the 2nd, 4th, 6th... alphabetic character, shift it to its immediate left neighbor in its row (e.g., w->q, q->p). Case is preserved (e.g., Q shifts to W or P depending on position). Non-alphabetic characters are left unchanged and do not increment the counter.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Identify the QWERTY row for each letter: Row 1 (qwertyuiop), Row 2 (asdfghjkl), Row 3 (zxcvbnm). Maintain a counter for alphabetic characters starting at 1. For the 1st, 3rd, 5th... alphabetic character, shift it to its immediate left neighbor in its row (e.g., w->q, q->p). For the 2nd, 4th, 6th... alphabetic character, shift it to its immediate right neighbor in its row (e.g., q->w, p->q). Case is preserved. Non-alphabetic characters are left unchanged and do not increment the counter.
